drawer.definition: a part of a table like a box that moves in and out
drawer.example: I open the drawer in the table.

while.example: I read while my friend writes.

example.definition: one thing that shows what a kind of thing is like
example.example: An apple is an example of fruit.

selection.definition: a thing you choose from a group
selection.example: My selection is the small cup.

cause.definition: something that makes an event take place
cause.example: The wind is the cause of this change.

purpose.example: My purpose is to carry the food home.

loss.definition: not having something that was your property
loss.example: The loss of my key is a problem.

rule.definition: a statement about what persons may or may not do
rule.example: There is a rule: keep your voice low.

journey.definition: the act of going from one place to another

dry.definition: with no water on or in it
dry.example: After some time, the cloth is dry.

art.definition: pictures and other things that express ideas or feelings
art.example: My art shows how I feel about the garden.

distance.example: The distance from home to the shop is short.

growth.example: This change is the growth of the tree.

support.definition: to help a person or thing
support.example: I support my friend by carrying some of the food.

opinion.definition: what a person has in mind about something
opinion.example: In my opinion, the small cup is best for me.

river.definition: a long, natural body of moving water on land
river.example: My friend and I walk near a river.

seed.definition: a small part of a plant from which a new plant can come

across.definition: from one side to the other

receipt.definition: a paper that shows a payment

pull.definition: to move a thing to you
pull.example: I pull the drawer to me.

observation.definition: a fact learned by looking with care
observation.example: One leaf is brown. That is my observation.

parcel.definition: a thing covered in paper for carrying or sending

news.example: My friend finished her work. This is the news in the letter.

between.example: I put the plant between the chair and the window.

slow.example: I carry the cup with slow steps.

if.definition: on the condition that something happens
if.example: If there is rain, I will be at home.

thread.definition: a thin line used for joining cloth
thread.example: The thread joins the button to the cloth.

but.definition: used to put different ideas together
but.example: The bag is small, but it is strong.
